description.value: Velocity Lounge & Driving Range is a technology-forward sports lounge at Naturally Pacific Resort, built around eight private Toptracer-powered virtual golf bays each seating up to eight guests. Full table service delivers food and drinks to every bay, making it as much a social dining destination as a golf facility. Touring cyclists passing through Campbell River can stop for a sit-down meal and drinks in a comfortable, resort-quality lounge setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Velocity Lounge & Driving Range is an active, open sports-entertainment venue at Naturally Pacific Resort in Campbell River, BC, featuring full table service food and drinks in eight private golf simulator bays. The OSM record lists no address or phone, both of which are confirmed from the website (700 Petersen Rd; 250-287-4970). No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, or cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so those remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
